Direct per-protein B*_Q6 codon-usage residual survival against measured PAXdb protein abundance after length, amino-acid composition, GC3, and M-density controls; this is a direct omics correlation, NOT a translation-mediated mechanism.
Per-protein B*_Q6 codon residual to protein-abundance association is decomposed by conditioning on modeled per-protein tAI; this is a statistical mediation decomposition, NOT a causal mechanism.

Per-protein B*_Q6 codon-usage residual association with AlphaFold mean pLDDT predicted structural-order confidence after length, 20 amino-acid composition, GC3, and M-density controls; this is NOT function, phenotype, causality, or experimental structural order.

Per-gene B*_Q6 codon residual association with lab knockout essentiality after amino-acid composition and measured protein-abundance control, using a binary linear-probability residualization; this is NOT causal and NOT a mechanism claim.
The four-case discriminant is an objective S^{QT}/S^{QP} sign plus mediation-condition classification over per-protein modeled-tAI and measured abundance readouts; it is not a mechanism claim.

Measured ribo-seq TE equals footprint/mRNA in the local source files, so the readout is already mRNA-normalized; this powered per-gene S^{QT,meas} reports codon residual survival against log10 measured TE after length, amino-acid composition, GC3, and M-density controls. The data are single/small-study, condition-specific, cross-sectional, and non-causal; the modeled-tAI contrast is a coordinate-pattern comparison only.

Codon residual to PAXdb protein-abundance association is decomposed by conditioning on measured ribo-seq log10(TE), not modeled tAI, across yeast, E. coli, human, and danio. This is a powered cross-sectional statistical mediation decomposition and comparison to the modeled-tAI mediation result; it is non-causal and not a mechanism claim.

For each organism, P_Q is the abundance component explained by residualized B*_Q6 coordinates, and P_Q_perp_T is the modeled-tAI-complement residual of that component. a_perp reads this residual back in the 9 B*_Q6 coordinates.
Measured ribo-seq TE is tested as a first H-candidate by projecting the modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized measured TE.
mRNA is tested as an H-candidate by projecting the modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized log10 mRNA.
Measured tRNA gene-copy tAI is tested for whether it absorbs the modeled-tAI-complement abundance component P_hat_{Q perp Tmod}.

UniProtKB reviewed subcellular localization is tested as an H-candidate by projecting the modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized multi-label localization one-hot columns, with a K-column dof-matched Gaussian null baseline.

UniProtKB reviewed protein features are tested as H-candidates by projecting the modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized one-column feature readouts, with per-candidate dof-matched Gaussian nulls and Bonferroni correction over organism x candidate tests.
Protein turnover/half-life is tested as a third H-candidate by projecting the modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized log10 Christiano 2014 half-life.
Mathieson 2018 human protein turnover is tested as an H-candidate by projecting the large human modeled-tAI complement abundance residual P_hat_{Q perp Tmod} onto residualized log10 half-life.
H-candidate readouts are ranked by direction-aware support for the modeled-tAI complement of the B*_Q6 abundance component.

For each organism with sufficient local readout data, R_0 = P_{Q perp Tmod}; a lambda-regularized greedy basis selects readout blocks H_k to absorb R_{k-1}, records rho_k decay, and compares each selected step with a dof-matched deterministic Gaussian null.
Organism-specific B*_Q6 cross-layer summaries are compared against domain, GC3, tRNA-pool size, and proteome-size proxies with deterministic permutation nulls.

Local codon-pair context lift Q^(2) explains the B*_Q6 -> protein-abundance residual that single-codon Q^(1) readouts leave irreducible: held-out 5-fold incremental Delta-R^2 of adjacent-codon synonymous B*_Q6 pair features (residualized against the 400 amino-acid-pair composition basis) exceeds the matched permutation null and clears the LAMBDA_DL complexity penalty. Tests whether the irreducible residual is local-context structure versus genuinely higher-order/non-local.

The B*_Q6 synonymous-codon residual association with yeast protein abundance is real (held-out 5-fold R^2 ~0.19 vs permutation null ~0) and partially reducible: a <=3-readout measured dictionary {measured_te, mrna_stability, turnover} captures ~24.5% of the Z-residualized abundance residual, surviving a selection-aware permutation null (null95 ~0.029, ~5x the naive fixed-subset null ~0.006); ~75% remains unexplained, and local codon-pair Q^(2) context adds no held-out signal. Certifies the residual as a real, partially-mediated (not irreducible) primitive over the tested readout family.

claims.statement: Hypothesis (tested, falsified): the B*_Q6 synonymous-codon residual on yeast protein abundance is an irreducible primitive -- a real held-out signal that NEITHER single-codon readout-dictionary compression NOR local codon-pair Q^(2) context captures. Result: source is real, but the {measured_te, mrna_stability, turnover} dictionary captures ~24.5% (selection-aware significant), so the residual is partially reducible, not irreducible. Explicit negative complementing the partial_mediation certificate.

A per-gene tRNA-supply readout (dos Reis tAI from yeast GtRNAdb tRNA gene-copy numbers + wobble) adds incremental held-out predictive power for Z-residualized yeast protein abundance BEYOND the measured {measured_te, mrna_stability, turnover} dictionary: 5-fold held-out delta-R^2 ~0.061 (base R^2 ~0.458 -> full ~0.519), exceeding a fixed-readout permutation null95 ~0.0007. Codon-level tRNA adaptation carries abundance information not captured by bulk measured translation efficiency, partly addressing the residual left unexplained by the partial_mediation dictionary.

Per-coordinate decomposition of the B*_Q6 -> yeast protein-abundance residual: of the 9 synonymous coordinates, 8 are real held-out abundance sources (K_AAA, Arg_AGR, Ile_AUA, Leu_CUN_vs_UUR, Leu_UUA_vs_UUG, Ser_UCR_vs_AGY, Thr_ACR_vs_ACY, f3_stress) and 1 (Ser_UCA_vs_UCG) is not; f3_stress carries the most residual energy (~20% of target, R^2~0.19) followed by Ile_AUA and Thr_ACR_vs_ACY. The measured {te,mrna_stability,turnover} dictionary's projection coverage exceeds the per-coordinate permutation null for the 8 real sources, but a large absolute residual energy remains unexplained per coordinate (e.g. f3_stress ~81% unexplained). Descriptive decomposition, not causal mediation.

The dominant B*_Q6 coordinate f3_stress (a global synonymous first-vs-last-codon direction across all 21 families) carrying ~20% of the abundance-residual energy is only MARGINALLY reachable by independent molecular measurements: the full {te,stability,turnover,localization,ptm,complex,tm,domain,mrna_abundance} readout set reaches best coverage 0.226 vs base {te,stability,turnover} 0.190 (increment +0.036, selection-aware-significant vs null95 0.027), but ~77.4% of f3_stress remains unexplained by ALL available measurements. The dominant frontier is largely orthogonal to current molecular readouts and needs new data/mechanism.
